## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Conflicting signals — VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing while GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD flagged create a mixed risk picture.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds supportive: SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY) ↑ rising; CPER/GLD (Copper/Gold) ↓ falling signalling disinflationary pressure.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: Dollar (Level) UUP proxy weaker — Dollar Strength (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -1.13%) → flat BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.98%) → flat RECOVERY, while credit spreads show subtle stress.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing steady strength: XLF (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND. Energy/Utilities lag: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperformance: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) CORRECTION — regional divergences persist.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows healthy but uneven: ARKK (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%) ABOVE TREND — watch momentum fade if breadth weakens.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals rally: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND; base metals CPER (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND but CPER/GLD ratio falling signals caution.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed and corrective: BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION, USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION, and UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND — watch for supply/demand headline-driven volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Broad equities leadership — SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND align with 8/11 sector strength. Divergences: multiple commodity/energy ETFs (BNO, USO, XLE) show 1W negative vs 1M positive → CORRECTION signals.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure anchored in XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and select materials/industrial exposure (XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to energy/utility exposures (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND) and monitor credit spreads.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND, UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION, USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) / LQD (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) — watch ratio ~0.80 for credit health. XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) vs XLF (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) — watch leadership cross for growth vs value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but mixed rate/credit and commodity signals create conflicting messages. Technology and materials showing relative strength (XLK and XME ABOVE TREND); key risk is corrective action in energy/commodity-linked ETFs (BNO, USO, XLE) to monitor.
